scope: Both sticks, fixed root, SAPIEN 3.0.3 SDF, native forces and contacts; raw travel fraction and unchanged public signal are both recorded.

T1.application: Inward along the current shaft at the cap center; tilt held by native force-mode joint drives, never by writing click position or target.
T1.fixture_basis: Numerical pose-holding fixture, not a gamepad parameter; both tilt drives only. Use actual shaft angle for force projection and report commanded angle error.

T2.scoring_window: Final 0.5 s; report middle-fraction for entire hold as well as final window to retain unavoidable loading transient.

T3.normal_direction: Inward shell-fixed click direction; constant force on the dynamic sphere, plus exact sphere gravity compensation. Tangential PD pushes across the cap upper side.
T3.placement: Frozen tilt contact ray on upper side, sphere initially tangent to the cooked cap surface; no geometry edits. Contact must be observed and shaft must tilt at least 1 degree.
T3.contact_force_measurement: Sum native contact impulses on stick / dt; record component along shell click axis and normal/tangential decomposition per contact.
T3.criterion: Every post-settle contact sample whose inward vertical normal-force component is <6.66 N must have raw fraction and signal <=0.05. Baseline uses identical fixture and is reported without requiring it to pass.

T4.criterion: No frozen baseline-passing case may regress; stop at the first regression, retain unrun cases as null.

stop_policy: Stop on failed key gate; no physical parameter or criterion changes after seeing results; at most three diagnostic figures. Execution bugs have at most three repair attempts, otherwise classify as a real failure.
